canonical_statement: For every measurable, finite-energy, weakly divergence-free velocity field on the Euclidean plane whose measurable scalar curl is essentially bounded, the unforced two-dimensional incompressible Euler equations admit a weak solution for all nonnegative real times, retaining finite energy, bounded vorticity, incompressibility, curl compatibility, the pressure-free weak momentum equation, and the initial vorticity trace.

canonical_formal_target.elaborated_expression: forall (u0 : Plane -> Plane) (omega0 : Plane -> Real), InitialData u0 omega0 -> Nonempty (GlobalWeakSolution u0 omega0)

domain_and_universes: Plane = EuclideanSpace Real (Fin 2); nonnegative real time; all declarations in Lean universe 0.
hypotheses: u0 and omega0 are a.e. strongly measurable for Euclidean volume
u0 belongs to L2 and omega0 belongs to L-infinity
omega0 is the weak scalar curl of u0
conclusion: Nonempty (GlobalWeakSolution u0 omega0), with fields covering every nonnegative real time and imposing the pressure-free distributional momentum equation and weak initial vorticity trace.

encoding_decisions.domain: the whole Euclidean plane; this avoids inventing an unresolved bounded-domain regularity and boundary class
encoding_decisions.solution: velocity-vorticity weak solution; pressure is eliminated by divergence-free compactly supported test fields
encoding_decisions.root_scope: existence only; uniqueness is not added because the repository target says global existence
encoding_decisions.regularity: finite-energy velocity and essentially bounded vorticity at every nonnegative time

mutation_tests: changed EuclideanSpace domain to the raw function type Fin 2 -> Real
changed binder scope so the initial-data premise is fixed at zero vorticity
boundary_policy: Zero initial data remains admitted. Bounded domains, the flat torus, forcing, uniqueness, continuous dependence, and smooth-data-only variants are not substituted for this whole-plane existence root.
status_boundary: This node freezes and elaborates the selected exact existence proposition. The Prop-valued PDE predicates are obligations, not assumed proofs of existence; no proof, source-fidelity, anchor-audit, obligation-tree, or release credit is claimed.
